summary: fix(settings): zero passkey PRF output on every non-stash exit
description:
Because:
- signin-passkey-auth.ts states that a caller zeroes prfOut once the
  assertion returns; no caller did, so the bytes stayed readable whenever
  the material was not held.

This commit:
- Zero prfOut when the interim wrap-offer stash does not hold it.
- Zero it on the merge-decline exit and in the sign-in catch.
